source: PolicyEngine-US 2.152.15 on Populace 2024 (populace-us-2024-spm-20260915), 2026 rules, take-up assumed; a calibrated synthetic population, not real people

questions.text: Which state do you live in?
How many people live in your household, including you?
How many children under 18 live with you?
Is anyone pregnant, or is there a baby under 1?
Is there a married couple in the household?
Roughly how much does the household earn from work in a year, before tax?
How much Social Security does the household get in a year?
Any other income a year (pensions, unemployment, interest, child support)?
What do you pay for rent or mortgage each month?
Do you rent, own, or neither?
How much do you spend on childcare in a year?
Does anyone get health insurance through a job?
Roughly how much is in bank accounts and investments?
Is anyone a full-time college student?
